_comment: The fine-tune on the prompt it was trained on (E', vote corrected) against DeepSeek on the defined-class prompt with five samples (C): each model on its own best prompt, both at five samples. Derived by paper/derive_best_prompt.py from the committed per-task exports with the estimator of model/scripts/matched_comparison.py; the script first reproduces D-C and E'-A from matched-comparison.json and stops if either differs. Exploratory on the same seed-777 pool for the same reasons as the other contrasts.
